title: Digital Accessibility Policy
description: All public-facing digital properties conform to WCAG AA standards. Accessibility is a release-blocking criterion.

sections.heading: Standard
sections.body: WCAG 2.2 Level AA compliance is required for all public digital properties.

sections.heading: Verification
sections.body: Automated accessibility scanning in CI/CD. Manual testing with screen readers and keyboard-only navigation before each production release.
